title: anamnesis-curation-policy/v1
description: The versioned rules a curation ran under. A release records the exact policy that produced it, because the same sources under a different policy are a different corpus and must not be compared as though they were the same one.

taxonomy.description: The severity vocabulary this policy admits. A source severity outside it is quarantined rather than mapped to the nearest neighbour, which is how taxonomy drift becomes silent.

disclosure.description: Which disclosure classes may contribute derived text to a release. A class absent here contributes identifiers and digests only.

scope.description: What this corpus preserves. Admission, curation and release refuse a source outside it and a record count outside its bounds, and the release id covers it because it covers the policy.
